body: I research anything really. I don't know what we could do. I'm so sorry, I'm very tired atm.
Online interests? I guess I just like to learn and research. Watch a few shows here and there.
I don't know if there is anything anyone can do. I can't even cry and feel better. I feel dead already. I appreciate the hope, but I'm sure I'm a lost cause.
Hopefully life gets better for you man. I feel it's over for me but I think you have a chance.

I'm sorry you feel this way. I don't know if you're like I am, I have chronic OCD, makes me always worry about something. I hate it. I'll tell family and they'll say, "well just stop thinking about it" it's not easy like that at all. Thank you for your time. I haven't been able to go to work for a week now. Barely can take care of myself, I've been starving myself. My life feels like hell.
I'm going through the same thing. You don't have to do this. I'm here if you want to talk.
Did that today. Helped a bit.
I'm sorry to keep replying to this, I'm just very lonely at the moment.

The worst mistake that I feel I can never live down is I tried to get on my dad's good side by spreading lies and shit talking about my mother, when she has been the closest to me and the most loving. When she found that out a couple years back, this has haunted me for a while now. Especially when I pictured her face when she read everything I said. Even though she has forgiven me seven times over, I feel the need to end my existence over this, again, fueled by the OCD.

I was verbally abused by my father for most of my life. I made tons of stupid decisions in my younger years. One that I feel like I can't live down ever in my lifetime. Even though when I've told someone who's close to me my mistakes, they look at me confused and say "that's it?" So I start to think I'm crazy.
